step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element capacitive network representing a wideband passive balun. It converts a single-ended RF input signal into differential output signals for driving a double-balanced mixer.

paper_reference.title: A Monolithic Double-Balanced Direct Conversion Mixer With an Integrated Wideband Passive Balun

Insertion_Loss.description: Signal loss from the input port to each output port, including the theoretical 3-dB power split.

sky130_expected.calculation: Passive network loss depends on dielectric loss and metal resistance rather than active device parameters.
sky130_expected.reasoning: An ideal power split is 3 dB. The additional 1.5 dB accounts for parasitic losses in the passive structure, which would be similar in SKY130 back-end-of-line (BEOL) metal layers.

Return_Loss.description: Reflection coefficient at the input port (S11), indicating impedance matching quality.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the specific sizing of the passive components to match 50 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A return loss of >15 dB is a standard target for RF input ports to ensure minimal signal reflection.

Amplitude_Imbalance.description: Difference in magnitude between the two differential output ports.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ideal is 0 dB. Depends on the symmetry of the layout and parasitic matching.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Good balun design aims for < 1 dB amplitude imbalance to maintain high common-mode rejection in the mixer.

Phase_Imbalance.description: Deviation from the ideal 180-degree phase difference between the two differential outputs.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Phase imbalance should be kept below 5 degrees to ensure proper double-balanced mixer operation and LO-RF isolation.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure insertion loss, return loss, amplitude imbalance, and phase imbalance of the passive balun at 30 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive Balun Testbench

* DUT (Capacitor values added for simulation validity)
C1 N1 N2 100f
C3 N1 N3 100f
C4 N2 N4 100f
C2 N3 N4 100f
C6 N3 GND 100f
C5 N4 GND 100f

* Sources and Terminations (50 ohm system)
V1 N_in GND dc 0 ac 2
R1 N_in N1 50
R2 N2 GND 50
R3 N3 GND 50
R4 N4 GND 50

.control
ac dec 50 1G 100G

* S-parameters (V_source = 2V -> V_incident = 1V)
let v_ref = v(N1) - 1
let s11_db = 20 * log10(mag(v_ref))
let s31_db = 20 * log10(mag(v(N3)))
let s41_db = 20 * log10(mag(v(N4)))

* Imbalance calculations
let amp_imb = s31_db - s41_db
let phase3 = 180/PI * cph(v(N3))
let phase4 = 180/PI * cph(v(N4))
let phase_diff = phase3 - phase4
let phase_imb = phase_diff - 180

* Measure metrics at 30 GHz (center of 20-40 GHz band)
meas ac il_31_30G find s31_db at=30G
meas ac il_41_30G find s41_db at=30G
meas ac rl_30G find s11_db at=30G
meas ac amp_imb_30G find amp_imb at=30G
meas ac phase_imb_30G find phase_imb at=30G

print il_31_30G il_41_30G rl_30G amp_imb_30G phase_imb_30G
quit
.endc
.end
